name: Kaelonnah Darlich
label: RESEARCH PRESENTATION · APRIL 2026
title: Monarch research on a national stage
intro: Millennium Scholar Kaelonnah Darlich presented at the National Conference on Undergraduate Research in Richmond, Virginia, in April 2026.
items: Her entomology research examines how simulated heat waves affect monarch butterfly development, reproduction, and mate selection.
She conducts this work with arthropod ecologist Mônica Kersch-Becker.
She also received a 2026 Stand Up Award for Undergraduate Ethical Leadership.
caption: Kaelonnah Darlich (right) with Donna Hercules at NCUR 2026. Photo published by Penn State.

name: Kieran Sturges
label: GOLDWATER SCHOLARSHIP · 2026–27
title: Computing that advances communication research
intro: Millennium Scholar Kieran Sturges earned a 2026–27 Goldwater Scholarship, recognizing his academic achievement and research experience.
items: His studies combine computer science and mathematics.
In Penn State’s Speech, Language and Swallowing study, he develops computational and AI-based methods to improve research procedures.
His research interests connect computing with communication sciences and disorders, including speech and swallowing outcomes in individuals with Down syndrome.

name: Bridget Reheard
label: ALUMNI ACHIEVEMENT · 2025
title: Environmental research and a national fellowship
intro: Millennium Scholar Bridget Reheard was named the College of Earth and Mineral Sciences’ summer 2025 student marshal and received a 2025 National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship.
items: She graduated summa cum laude with a 4.0 GPA and degrees in geosciences and wildlife and fisheries science.
Her undergraduate research examined shale gas development and aquatic communities, alongside summer projects involving environmental contaminants.
Penn State reported that she would begin doctoral study in Integrated Toxicology and Environmental Health at Duke University in fall 2025.
